definitions.explanation: The branch of medicine dealing with surgical procedures. Also refers to the surgical department in a hospital.

examples.japanese: {外科|げか}で{手術|しゅじゅつ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I had surgery in the surgical department.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{外科|げか}{医|い}になりたい。
examples.english: She wants to become a surgeon.

examples.japanese: {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}で{膝|ひざ}を{診|み}てもらった。
examples.english: I had my knee examined at orthopedic surgery.

notes:
{外科|げか} refers to the branch of medicine dealing with surgical procedures, or the surgical department in a hospital. A compound of {外|がい} (outer) + {科|か} (department/specialty).

COMMON TYPES:
- {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}: orthopedic surgery
- {脳|のう}{外科|げか}: neurosurgery
- {心臓|しんぞう}{外科|げか}: cardiac surgery
- {美容|びよう}{外科|げか}: cosmetic surgery

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {外科|げか}{医|い}: surgeon
- {外科|げか}{手術|しゅじゅつ}: surgical operation

CONTRAST:
{内科|ないか} (internal medicine) is the non-surgical counterpart. Together, {外科|げか} and {内科|ないか} form the two fundamental divisions of clinical medicine.
